hotkeyHelp: Control + Option + Space opens or hides Launchpad.
styleHelp: Switch styles without changing your layout.
importHelp: Preview an old Launchpad database. Your original files stay untouched.
importNote: Your current Sunny layout is backed up before replacement. Missing apps keep their positions.
noDatabase: No old database found. Choose a backup file if you have one.
restoreConfirm: Restore this backup? Your current Sunny data will be backed up first.
readOnly: Data could not be loaded. Editing is disabled to protect the original file.
invalidLayout: This layout contains invalid or duplicate entries.
unsupportedVersion: This data was created by an unsupported version. The original is preserved.
corruptData: The file is damaged or is not a valid Sunny backup.
unavailableApp: This app is unavailable. Reinstall it, then refresh applications.
unsupportedDatabase: This is not a supported Launchpad database.
changingDatabase: The source is changing. Try again with a stable backup.
oversizedDatabase: The database exceeds the supported size.
emptyImport: No visible apps were found in this layout.
storageUnavailable: Storage is unavailable. Check the data folder permissions.
hotkeyError: The shortcut could not be registered. It may be in use.
aboutText:
A familiar place for your apps.
Made for macOS 26 and later.
dragHint: Drag the center to group, or the edge to reorder.
